title: Donut Boat- Self Captained -All Electric
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the serene waters of Lake Austin with a self-captained electric donut boat, designed for fun and relaxation. Perfect for up to 10 guests, this unique floating lounge allows you to navigate at your own pace without the need for a boating license. With a built-in table, comfortable seating, and a Bluetooth speaker, you can enjoy your own music and bring along your favorite food and drinks (no glass). Choose from 1, 1.5, or 2-hour rental options to create a memorable outing whether for a birthday celebration or a casual day with family and friends.

- Private electric donut boat rental for up to 10 guests
- No boating license required for self-captained fun
- Flexible rental durations of 1, 1.5, or 2 hours
- Amenities include a center table, shaded umbrella, and Bluetooth speaker

Enjoy a safe and relaxing cruise in a designated no-wake zone near Mozart’s Coffee Roasters.
